text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski has decided to thoroughly reconstruct the government, replacing eight or nine ministers. Unofficially, defence minister Blagoj Handziski to become new foreign minister, Gorgi Spasov justice minister, construction minister Dimitar Buzlevski to become new deputy prime minister.
- Four Macedonians knock over pole with Albanian flag outside the local municipality offices in Gostivar early on Monday, starting a fight with a group of Albanians.
- "The radical statements of Gostivar mayor (an ethnic Albanian) provoked the incident in the town. One radicalism can only lead to another," says Nova Makedonija in a commentary.

- "The Macedonian government cannot accept the proposal of depositors of the bankrupt TAT financial savings institution from Bitola," finance minister Taki Fiti said. Depositors threaten to take over the property of TAT owner Sonja Nikolovska. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
